titleEn: Connect the agent to your own systems (webhook / Odoo)

en: Can the agent call my own system or Odoo?

steps: Connect systems > Agent connectors > Add a connector

Webhook (https:443, tools as JSON) or Odoo (url, database, login, API key); secret is write-only and encrypted with AGENT_SECRETS_KEY, a GET returns hasSecret only; secret minimum 16 (webhook) / 8 (odoo); a super admin member reads status only, never writes
Save asks for an explicit confirm naming the host and the tools the agent will be able to call
Test the connection (one per 5 s); delete asks first
edgeCases: Erased/STOP customers make no connector call
assistantNote: gives the agent tool access to external systems
